name: Dalías (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dalías (a ship on red within a ring inscribed CIUDAD DE DALÍAS).
history: Dalías adopted its arms officially on 16 March 1959 and uses a flag of its own without official registration, described as a rectangular white flag with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Dalías arms — ship on red within an inscribed ring
